title: Architecture Decision Record v2
description: Frontmatter contract for scoped ADR markdown under law/adr/. Identity is ADR-<SCOPE>-<NNNN> and is mandatory. Supersession is recorded forward on the superseding record only: this contract has no superseded_by field, so a superseding decision never requires editing the bytes of the record it supersedes. Frontmatter is restricted to scalars and block string arrays so the governed frontmatter reader parses it without a general YAML engine.

id.description: Mandatory scoped identity. The one-or-more scope segments are the sole scope declaration; scope is never restated in a separate field.

status.description: Exactly four lifecycle values. Only accepted is binding; proposed, rejected, and superseded carry no authority over the reference signal.

authority.description: Article 6 binds law/adr to Architect authority. No other authority may author an ADR.

supersedes.description: Exact identities of the records this decision supersedes. This is the sole supersession mechanism: the superseded record is never edited.

inspector_acceptance.description: Adversarial acceptance obligations the Inspector must discharge before the decision is treated as demonstrated. Each entry names one attack the contract must survive, not one happy-path assertion.

items.description: The separator is ' -- ' rather than ': ' so the entry stays an unquoted plain scalar in frontmatter and the governed frontmatter reader returns the text without surrounding quote characters.

disposition.description: Why a non-binding record is non-binding. Required for rejected and superseded records.

adr_reference.description: A v2 scoped identity, a legacy numeric identity, or an explicitly catalogued LEGACY: identity. A LEGACY: reference resolves only through the validation policy's exact reference allowlist.

affected_rule_subject.description: Lexically canonical repository-relative POSIX governed or review subject. It has no POSIX or Windows-drive absolute form, dot segment, repeated separator, backslash, NUL, glob, or trailing separator. Semantic resolution requires input already normalized to Unicode NFC and performs no filesystem or Git lookup.

examples.title: Example scoped decision
inspector_acceptance: IA-001 -- A record with a missing id is rejected rather than defaulted to a derived id.
